sources.articleTitle: About 3 million S’poreans to receive $100 to $250 Assurance Package cash payouts in December

headline: Singaporeans To Receive Final Assurance Package Payouts In December
metaDescription: Approximately 3 million Singaporean citizens are set to receive final cash disbursements ranging from $100 to $250 through the Assurance Package.
aiSummaryBullets: Approximately 3 million eligible Singaporeans are scheduled to receive cash payouts in December.
The payments will range between $100 and $250 per individual recipient.
This distribution represents the concluding disbursement of the enhanced Assurance Package.
aiContextParagraph: The government of Singapore has announced the final round of financial support under the enhanced Assurance Package. First introduced during the 2023 national budget, the initiative was designed to assist citizens with rising living costs through a series of structured cash disbursements. As of November 2026, authorities confirmed that the upcoming payments, which will be issued to roughly 3 million residents, mark the conclusion of the scheduled payouts. The amounts allocated to individual recipients vary from $100 to $250 based on criteria established during the program's initial rollout. This package serves as a component of broader fiscal strategies aimed at mitigating economic pressure on the population. The December disbursement effectively closes out the multi-year support program that was originally outlined in the fiscal planning of 2023, representing the final financial installment delivered to eligible citizens as part of this specific policy framework.
